sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: P02 2009 Computers and communications, camera paragraph

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Owner recognition by a built-in camera becomes a reliable routine consumer-computing function.
reference.rationale: Webcams and face recognition existed, but reliable everyday authentication was not yet routine across ordinary personal devices in 2009. Face ID on the shipping 2017 iPhone X is a clear practical implementation. This establishes late realization without claiming that it was the first face-recognition computer.
